opening.question: Does the opening establish the subject and visual identity?
opening.evidence: Frame 0.3s (review-beats) and 4.2s (settled): night-sky world, HUD title, gold TWO already readable at frame 0, Earth with orbit; subject and visual identity clear. Orbit/moon seen at 0.3s, 2.5s, 4.2s.

narrative.question: Is the narrative understandable?
narrative.evidence: Settled frames 4.2/9.9/16.4/22.9/27.16s: orbit + two tides -> two labelled bulges -> Earth spinning under them with elapsed hours -> gauge/curve at 12.4 h -> three summary cards + closing line. Captions at those frames read as the narration of each beat (synthetic timing).

scene-purpose.question: Does every scene have a clear purpose?
scene-purpose.evidence: every scene has purpose + viewerShouldNotice; none flagged generic

variation.question: Is there meaningful visual variation?
variation.evidence: Five different hero objects (orbit path, CSS-3D Earth with callouts, top-down spinning Earth, gauge + tide curve, three cards); five layouts per storyboard. Same sky/HUD/captions throughout by design.

typography.question: Is the typography readable and well composed?
typography.evidence: Montserrat headings, JetBrains Mono values, Poppins notes legible in all settled frames; hyperframes craft check reports no text under 28px after the size revision. Not checked: phone-width review strip (review-phone.jpg) was not opened.

transitions.question: Are transitions consistent and intentional?
transitions.evidence: Cloud-bank sweep seen mid-pass at 5.3/11.3/18.3/24.3s; after the fix it no longer clips content at rest (frames 0.3s, 14s clean). Exact moment of full coverage at each cut was not captured.

timing.question: Are there awkward gaps, overlaps or timing conflicts?

clipping.question: Are elements clipped or outside safe areas?
clipping.evidence: No clipped text in settled frames; hyperframes layout check 0 errors. Remaining visual nit: the leader line of the 12.4 h callout crosses the top of the second HIGH label (22.9s).

assets.question: Are images and assets used effectively?
assets.evidence: No external assets; Earth, Moon, gauge, curve, icons all drawn (SVG/CSS 3D). Captions use synthetic word timing, disclosed in the brief; there is no audio.

arc.question: Does the video have a coherent beginning, middle and end?
arc.evidence: roles open with hook/context and close with payoff/resolution/cta

effects.question: Are there unnecessary effects or repetitive layouts?
effects.evidence: Source scan clean (no glow classes beyond the single sky light wash, no unlogged drift). Every tween maps to the storyboard hero move, callout or caption.

technical.question: Does the project pass the supported technical checks?
technical.evidence: hyperframes check + lint + structure: no errors
